  <bpmn:process id="PROCESS" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LANES">
      <bpmn:lane id="LANE_HEAD" name="Head of Functional Department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>START</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>REPORT_VACANCY</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CLARIFY</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>REVIEW</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CORRECTIONS_NEEDED</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>REQUEST_CORRECTIONS</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>APPROVE</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>END</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="LANE_HR" name="Personnel Department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>MERGE_DESCRIBE</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>DESCRIBE</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>QUESTIONS_NEEDED</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>ASK_QUESTIONS</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>REVISE</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>MERGE_SUBMIT</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SUBMIT</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="START" name="Personnel requirement detected" />
    <bpmn:task id="REPORT_VACANCY" name="Report the vacancy to the Personnel Department" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="MERGE_DESCRIBE" />
    <bpmn:task id="DESCRIBE" name="Describe the job" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="QUESTIONS_NEEDED" name="Questions about tasks and requirements?" />
    <bpmn:task id="ASK_QUESTIONS" name="Ask questions about the tasks and requirements" />
    <bpmn:task id="CLARIFY" name="Clarify the tasks and requirements" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="MERGE_SUBMIT" />
    <bpmn:task id="SUBMIT" name="Submit the job description for review" />
    <bpmn:task id="REVIEW" name="Review the job description" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="CORRECTIONS_NEEDED" name="Corrections needed?" />
    <bpmn:task id="REQUEST_CORRECTIONS" name="Request corrections of the job description" />
    <bpmn:task id="REVISE" name="Revise the job description" />
    <bpmn:task id="APPROVE" name="Approve the job description" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="END" name="Job description approved" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F1" sourceRef="START" targetRef="REPORT_VACANCY" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F2" sourceRef="REPORT_VACANCY" targetRef="MERGE_DESCRIBE" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F3" sourceRef="MERGE_DESCRIBE" targetRef="DESCRIBE" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F4" sourceRef="DESCRIBE" targetRef="QUESTIONS_NEEDED" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F5" name="Yes" sourceRef="QUESTIONS_NEEDED" targetRef="ASK_QUESTIONS" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F6" sourceRef="ASK_QUESTIONS" targetRef="CLARIFY" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F7" sourceRef="CLARIFY" targetRef="MERGE_DESCRIBE" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F8" name="No" sourceRef="QUESTIONS_NEEDED" targetRef="MERGE_SUBMIT" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F9" sourceRef="MERGE_SUBMIT" targetRef="SUBMIT" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F10" sourceRef="SUBMIT" targetRef="REVIEW" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F11" sourceRef="REVIEW" targetRef="CORRECTIONS_NEEDED" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F12" name="Yes" sourceRef="CORRECTIONS_NEEDED" targetRef="REQUEST_CORRECTIONS" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F13" sourceRef="REQUEST_CORRECTIONS" targetRef="REVISE" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F14" sourceRef="REVISE" targetRef="MERGE_SUBMIT" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F15" name="No" sourceRef="CORRECTIONS_NEEDED" targetRef="APPROVE" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F16" sourceRef="APPROVE" targetRef="END" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
